chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
We found in the Book of Ali (peace be upon him): Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When the Zakat is prevented, the earth is prevented from its blessings.'
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of preventing Zakat on the earth's blessings?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith traces its chain back to Imam al-Sadiq, who attributes the saying to the Prophet Muhammad, linking it to the 'Kitab Ali' (Book of Ali) tradition. It underscores a key Shia theological principle that the proper administration of Zakat is not merely a fiscal duty but a spiritual mechanism that unlocks the earth's material and spiritual barakah. This causal relationship highlights how communal neglect of religious obligations directly impacts cosmic and agricultural prosperity.
